about_short_description.short_description: Converge Bio integrates Generative AI with biological data.

product.name: ConvergeAB™
product.description: An AI platform for antibody design, screening, and optimization, supporting de novo design, affinity maturation, humanization, and developability assessment across multiple antibody formats.

product.name: ConvergeCELL™
product.description: An AI platform that analyzes single-cell and bulk RNA-seq data to identify disease-associated targets, biomarkers, patient subgroups, and therapeutic hypotheses.

product.name: ConvergeGEO™
product.description: A generative AI platform for optimizing gene expression and therapeutic protein production by designing codons, UTRs, promoters, and terminators.

product.name: Converge Computational Lab
product.description: A managed generative AI platform for life-science R&D that combines biological foundation models with applications for prediction, explainability, and generation.
